$comment: Metadata for dayz_openxr.ini used by tools/config-editor. Keys mirror the ini; live = changeable through the debug plugin, restart = read only when the hooks install. tests/test_config_schema.py keeps this in step with the ini and the native tunable tables.

openxr.title: OpenXR runtime
openxr.description: How the proxy starts the OpenXR session.

enabled.title: Enable OpenXR
enabled.description: Start the OpenXR session and present DayZ to the headset. Off, the proxy only forwards DXGI calls, which is the safe first test of an install.

debug_layer.title: OpenXR debug layer
debug_layer.description: Not read by the current build; the OpenXR validation layer is never requested.

reference_space.title: Reference space
reference_space.description: Not read by the current build; the host always creates a LOCAL space (seated/standing from the runtime origin).

mode.title: Render mode
mode.description: Not read by the current build: the host shows its diagnostic grid until DayZ delivers frames and the game image from then on, with no setting involved. Kept for file compatibility.

submit_when_unfocused.title: Submit while unfocused
submit_when_unfocused.description: Not read by the current build. Frames are submitted whenever the session is focused; see [hooks] keep_focus for the frame-rate behaviour.

gui.title: Menus and inventory
gui.description: The world-locked GUI quad for the main menu and inventory, and inventory behaviour.

quad_enabled.title: GUI quad
quad_enabled.description: Capture the main menu and inventory separately and show them on a world-locked quad in front of the headset while cursor mode is open. The in-game HUD keeps its own path.

quad_pixel_width.title: Quad texture width
quad_pixel_width.description: Width of the texture the GUI quad is rendered into.

quad_pixel_height.title: Quad texture height
quad_pixel_height.description: Height of the texture the GUI quad is rendered into.

quad_width_meters.title: Quad width
quad_width_meters.description: Physical width of the GUI quad in the world.

quad_distance.title: Quad distance
quad_distance.description: Distance from the headset at which the quad is anchored when it opens.

quad_vertical_offset.title: Quad vertical offset
quad_vertical_offset.description: Vertical shift of the quad relative to eye height; negative moves it down.

inventory_hmd_look.title: Head look in inventory
inventory_hmd_look.description: Keep head look active while DayZ owns the mouse for the in-game inventory. Main-menu cursor mode is not affected.

inventory_preview_rotation_scale.title: Preview rotation compensation
inventory_preview_rotation_scale.description: Fraction of head rotation used to keep the 3D character preview aligned with the world-locked inventory. Item previews follow the GUI without compensation.

inventory_player_preview_visible.title: Show character preview
inventory_player_preview_visible.description: Show the inventory's 3D character preview. Off hides it without changing the item panels.

inventory_blur_enabled.title: Inventory background blur
inventory_blur_enabled.description: Allow DayZ's Gauss post-process blur behind the in-game inventory. Off suppresses it while the character-preview camera is active.

controls.title: Controllers
controls.description: Tracked controller input, pointer rays and stick turning.

enabled.title: Controller input
enabled.description: Read the tracked controllers and emulate DayZ's keyboard and mouse from them (see the mapping table in the README).

show_controller_axes.title: Show controller axes
show_controller_axes.description: Draw diagnostic XYZ axes at each controller pose.

show_gui_ray.title: Show GUI pointer ray
show_gui_ray.description: Draw the translucent cyan pointer ray from the right controller while the main menu or inventory is visible.

show_direction_rays.title: Show direction rays
show_direction_rays.description: Draw the gameplay direction probes: HMD white, right aim blue, native DayZ camera yellow, final render camera magenta.

deadzone.title: Stick deadzone
deadzone.description: Stick deflection ignored around the centre, as a fraction of full deflection.

turn_rate.title: Smooth turn rate
turn_rate.description: Right-stick smooth turning speed at full deflection, with the closed-loop aim. 0 disables smooth turning.

recenter_stick_click.title: Stick click recenters
recenter_stick_click.description: Clicking the left thumbstick recenters the view, like the recenter hotkey.

snap_turn.title: Snap turn angle
snap_turn.description: Degrees turned once per right-stick flick. Greater than 0 replaces smooth turning with snap turning.

turn_scale.title: Open-loop turn scale
turn_scale.description: Fallback when the closed-loop aim is off: relative mouse counts injected per frame at full stick deflection.

logging.title: Logging
logging.description: The proxy's own log file beside DayZ_x64.exe.

level.title: Log level
level.description: Not read by the current build; every info and error line is written regardless.

file.title: Log file
file.description: File name of the log, relative to the DayZ directory. A fresh file is started on every launch, the previous one kept as .1.

debug.title: Debug plugin
debug.description: Optional runtime control plugin used by dayz-vr-ctl.py and this editor's live apply.

enabled.title: Load debug plugin
enabled.description: Load dayz_openxr_debug.dll from the game directory. It serves live tracking state and runtime tunables on the loopback port below. Off by default; the DLL is optional.

port.title: Debug port
port.description: TCP port on 127.0.0.1 the plugin listens on. This editor and dayz-vr-ctl.py connect here.

plugin.title: Plugin file name
plugin.description: File name of the debug plugin DLL in the DayZ directory.

hooks.title: Engine hooks
hooks.description: Which swap-chain and window hooks are installed.

enabled.title: Install hooks
enabled.description: Master switch for the DXGI swap-chain hooks. Off, nothing is intercepted and VR cannot work.

present.title: Hook Present
present.description: Intercept IDXGISwapChain::Present to capture and submit frames.

present1.title: Hook Present1
present1.description: Intercept IDXGISwapChain1::Present1 as well (used by DayZ on newer swap-chain paths).

resize_buffers.title: Hook ResizeBuffers
resize_buffers.description: Intercept ResizeBuffers so capture resources follow window and resolution changes.

keep_focus.title: Keep full frame rate unfocused
keep_focus.description: DayZ drops to about 20 fps when its window is not in the foreground, which in VR is most of the time. Make the engine see its window as always active. Head-look and controller input still need real window focus because they use SendInput.

stereo.title: Stereo and camera
stereo.description: Eye presentation, head aim, closed loop, image fitting and HUD layout.

runtime_probe.title: Runtime probe
runtime_probe.description: Validate the exact DayZ build and install the camera/render hooks. Required for everything below; off leaves only the plain frame mirror.

alternate_eye.title: Alternate eyes
alternate_eye.description: Render one eye per game frame (each eye at half the frame rate).

stereo_mode.title: Stereo mode
stereo_mode.description: alternate: one eye per game frame. double (experimental): call DayZ's world render twice per frame; currently both passes draw the same view and the frame rate halves. Falls back to alternate on an unknown build.

double_capture_clear.title: Double-mode capture clear
double_capture_clear.description: Double mode only: DayZ clears two full-size targets per pass; the left eye is captured right before this clear of the frame (3 = start of the right pass).

hmd_rotation.title: Apply head rotation
hmd_rotation.description: Apply the headset rotation to DayZ's camera during view preparation.

hmd_native_aim.title: Native head aim
hmd_native_aim.description: Route head yaw/pitch through DayZ's mouse camera so the aim ray, shots, body and first-person weapon use exactly the rendered direction. Roll stays a render-only transform.

hmd_position_scale.title: Position scale
hmd_position_scale.description: Metres of DayZ camera translation per metre of physical head movement. Note: the current DayZ build ignores the camera translation, so this has no visible effect yet.

game_fov.title: Gameplay FOV
game_fov.description: Absolute DayZ gameplay FOV in radians, applied only to the in-memory profile value; .DayZProfile is never written. 0 disables the override. 1.4835 rad = 85 deg.

hmd_mouse_yaw_scale.title: Yaw counts per radian
hmd_mouse_yaw_scale.description: Signed mouse counts per radian of head yaw. With the closed loop this is only the starting guess; invert the sign if yaw moves the wrong way.

hmd_mouse_pitch_scale.title: Pitch counts per radian
hmd_mouse_pitch_scale.description: Signed mouse counts per radian of head pitch. With the closed loop this is only the starting guess; invert the sign if pitch moves the wrong way.

lock_yaw.title: Lock yaw
lock_yaw.description: The headset no longer drives DayZ's mouse camera in yaw; the rendered view still follows your head. Turn with the stick or mouse while looking around. Default hotkey F11.

lock_pitch.title: Lock pitch
lock_pitch.description: The headset no longer drives DayZ's mouse camera in pitch; the rendered view still follows your head. Keeps the aim level while looking up or down. Default hotkey F10.

hmd_aim_closed_loop.title: Closed-loop head aim
hmd_aim_closed_loop.description: Every frame compare where DayZ's camera points with the headset and inject only the mouse counts needed to close the gap, learning the real counts-per-radian while playing. DayZ scales mouse deltas by frame time, so the fixed scales above only fit one frame rate.

aim_residual_render.title: Render the loop residual
aim_residual_render.description: Draw the loop's remaining yaw/pitch error on the render side so the eyes stay exactly on the head while DayZ's camera catches up a frame later. Otherwise the world and the hands judder by that residual while the game is focused. Not used while controller aim drives the camera.

hmd_aim_loop_damping.title: Loop damping
hmd_aim_loop_damping.description: Fraction of the remaining aim error corrected per frame. Lower is smoother and slower.

hmd_aim_loop_max_counts.title: Loop count cap
hmd_aim_loop_max_counts.description: Hard cap on injected mouse counts per frame and axis.

controller_aim.title: Controller aim
controller_aim.description: DayZ's camera, and so the weapon, follows the right controller's aim pose while your eyes keep showing where your head points. Needs the closed loop; falls back to head aim when the controller is not tracked. Default hotkey F12.

camera_separation.title: Camera separation
camera_separation.description: Distance between the two game cameras in DayZ world units. Note: has no visible effect on the current build (camera translation is ignored).

image_shift.title: Image shift
image_shift.description: Symmetric screen-space shift as a fraction of one eye image width. Positive moves the left image left and the right image right.

fit_mode.title: Fit mode
fit_mode.description: contain keeps the aspect with bars, stretch fills the eye, cover crops to fill.

scale_x.title: Image scale X
scale_x.description: Final horizontal image scale. Below 1 shrinks, above 1 crops/overscans.

scale_y.title: Image scale Y
scale_y.description: Final vertical image scale. Below 1 shrinks, above 1 crops/overscans.

override_hud_scale.title: Override HUD scale
override_hud_scale.description: Replace DayZ's native IGUIScale with the value below (stock fallback is 0.85).

hud_scale.title: HUD scale
hud_scale.description: Native IGUIScale used when the override is on.

hud_safe_width.title: HUD safe width
hud_safe_width.description: Width of the HUD safe area in pixels; 0 uses the full frame.

hud_safe_height.title: HUD safe height
hud_safe_height.description: Height of the HUD safe area in pixels; 0 uses the full frame.

hud_composite_width.title: HUD composite width
hud_composite_width.description: Experimental centred viewport width for identifying the native HUD draw pass; 0 disables.

hud_composite_height.title: HUD composite height
hud_composite_height.description: Experimental centred viewport height for identifying the native HUD draw pass; 0 disables.

hud_left_offset_x.title: HUD left eye offset
hud_left_offset_x.description: Horizontal HUD offset for the left eye.

hud_right_offset_x.title: HUD right eye offset
hud_right_offset_x.description: Horizontal HUD offset for the right eye.

gui_mouse_remap.title: Remap GUI mouse
gui_mouse_remap.description: Translate mouse movement into DayZ's GUI coordinate space for the virtual cursor.

gui_cursor.title: Virtual GUI cursor
gui_cursor.description: Lock the system cursor to the window centre while a menu is open and draw the mod's own cursor into the VR-visible interface layer.

override_game_resolution.title: Override render resolution
override_game_resolution.description: Force the backbuffer to the width and height below (square images suit headsets; UI sizing follows the frame height, so expect larger UI).

render_width.title: Render width
render_width.description: Backbuffer width used when the override is on.

render_height.title: Render height
render_height.description: Backbuffer height used when the override is on.

vignette.title: Locomotion vignette
vignette.description: Darken the edges of each eye while moving or smooth-turning with the sticks. Snap turns never vignette.

vignette_strength.title: Vignette strength
vignette_strength.description: Darkness at the edge, 0 none to 1 black.

vignette_radius.title: Vignette radius
vignette_radius.description: Clear centre as a fraction of the eye image.

vignette_fade_seconds.title: Vignette fade
vignette_fade_seconds.description: Seconds to fade the vignette in and out.

hud.title: Ammo display
hud.description: World-space ammo counter anchored to the right controller (needs the @DayZVR bridge).

ammo_quad.title: Ammo quad
ammo_quad.description: Show the small world-space seven-segment ammo display ("30+1") above the right hand. Amber below six rounds, red when empty. Needs [bridge] enabled and -mod=@DayZVR.

ammo_quad_width_meters.title: Ammo quad width
ammo_quad_width_meters.description: Physical width of the ammo quad.

ammo_quad_offset_x.title: Ammo quad offset X
ammo_quad_offset_x.description: Offset in the right grip pose, x right.

ammo_quad_offset_y.title: Ammo quad offset Y
ammo_quad_offset_y.description: Offset in the right grip pose, y up along the handle top.

ammo_quad_offset_z.title: Ammo quad offset Z
ammo_quad_offset_z.description: Offset in the right grip pose, z back towards the wrist.

ammo_quad_tilt_degrees.title: Ammo quad tilt
ammo_quad_tilt_degrees.description: Rotation of the quad about its x axis so it faces the eyes.

ammo_quad_pixel_height.title: Ammo quad texture height
ammo_quad_pixel_height.description: Height of the texture the digits are rasterised into.

melee.title: Motion melee
melee.description: Swing the right controller to attack with fists or a melee weapon (needs the @DayZVR bridge). Off until the thresholds are tuned on a real headset.

motion_swing.title: Motion melee
motion_swing.description: Right-controller swings press DayZ's attack button while fists or a melee weapon are in hands.

light_speed.title: Light swing speed
light_speed.description: A swing starts when the grip moves faster than this.

heavy_speed.title: Heavy swing speed
heavy_speed.description: A swing peaking at or above this holds the attack button for the heavy attack; slower swings tap it.

cooldown_seconds.title: Swing cooldown
cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum time between two swing events.

heavy_hold_seconds.title: Heavy hold time
heavy_hold_seconds.description: How long the attack button is held for a heavy attack (DayZ needs it held through the wind-up).

fire.title: Vibrate on fire
fire.description: Pulse the right controller for every round the @DayZVR bridge reports as fired (magazine plus chamber dropping by one while the weapon stays the same).

fire_amplitude.title: Fire pulse strength
fire_amplitude.description: Amplitude of the fire pulse, 0 to 1.

stance.title: Physical stance
stance.description: Crouch and prone from head height (needs the @DayZVR bridge for the stance readback).

physical.title: Physical crouch/prone
physical.description: The head dropping below the standing height (captured at the first tracked frame and after every recenter) taps DayZ's crouch and prone toggles until the game reports the matching stance.

crouch_drop.title: Crouch drop
crouch_drop.description: Head drop below standing height that counts as crouching.

prone_drop.title: Prone drop
prone_drop.description: Head drop below standing height that counts as prone.

hysteresis.title: Stance hysteresis
hysteresis.description: Extra distance the head must move back before a stance toggles again, so head bobbing does not flip it.

vehicle.title: Vehicles
vehicle.description: View lock, two-hand steering wheel and trigger pedals while driving (needs the @DayZVR bridge).

lock_view.title: Lock view in vehicles
lock_view.description: While in a vehicle both head axes stay render-only (like lock yaw plus lock pitch), so looking around the cabin does not make the aim loop drag DayZ's vehicle-relative camera after a world-space head direction.

steering.title: Controller steering wheel
steering.description: The line between the left and right grips is the wheel rim; tilting it (right hand down = clockwise) steers right through the bridge and Car.SetSteering. Keyboard/stick steering keeps working when both hands are not tracked. The triggers become pedals while driving (right throttle, left brake).

wheel_max_degrees.title: Full-lock tilt
wheel_max_degrees.description: Rim tilt that gives full steering lock.

deadzone.title: Steering deadzone
deadzone.description: Fraction of the tilt range ignored around centre.

require_grip.title: Require both grips
require_grip.description: Hold both grips (squeeze above 50 %) to take the wheel; release to let go.

bridge.title: Script bridge
bridge.description: File exchange with the optional @DayZVR Enforce Script mod under <profile>/dayzvr/ (<profile> is %LOCALAPPDATA%\DayZ unless DayZ runs with -profiles=).

enabled.title: Enable bridge
enabled.description: Write vr.txt (poses, aim state, controller buttons) and read game.txt (weapon, ammo, health level, stance, vehicle) every interval. Needs -mod=@DayZVR for anything to answer.

interval_frames.title: Bridge interval
interval_frames.description: Frames between two bridge exchanges. 6 is about 10 Hz at 60 fps.

ammo_counter.title: Screen-space ammo label
ammo_counter.description: The @DayZVR mod draws the magazine's round count as a small label next to the aim point (hidden with the HUD, in menus and when nothing with a magazine is held). The fallback for the ammo quad.

dashboard.title: Vehicle dashboard
dashboard.description: While driving, the mod draws one line with speed, gear, rpm, fuel, engine and lights at the bottom of the HUD (hidden in menus and the inventory).

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.description: Keyboard hotkeys polled while DayZ is the foreground window. Format: optional modifier chain plus a key, e.g. F9, ctrl+alt+home, shift+numpad5, 0x78. Empty disables.

recenter.title: Recenter hotkey
recenter.description: Recapture the head yaw and position centre so the current pose becomes straight ahead.

toggle1.title: Toggle hotkey 1
toggle1.description: "<key> <section.key>": flips a boolean live tunable while playing. Any bool from the tunables list works.

toggle2.title: Toggle hotkey 2
toggle2.description: "<key> <section.key>": flips a boolean live tunable while playing.

toggle3.title: Toggle hotkey 3
toggle3.description: "<key> <section.key>": flips a boolean live tunable while playing.

patches.title: Engine patches
patches.description: Workarounds for DayZ engine bugs the proxy exposes (see common/dayz_patches.cpp).

guard_execute_without_prepared_view.title: Guard executeView
guard_execute_without_prepared_view.description: DayZ 1.29 can execute a render view whose prepared-view pointer was already cleared (seen after dragging the game window) and crashes at DayZ+0x1DDE4B. The guard skips that single call and logs it.
